name: heading
label: Heading
help_text: The welcome card heading. You can insert HubSpot personalisation tokens here (e.g. Welcome back, [firstname]).

name: heading_level
label: Heading Level
help_text: Controls the HTML heading tag. Use H1 only once per page for the main title.

name: body_text
label: Body Text
help_text: Introductory paragraph shown below the heading. Supports rich text formatting.
default: Your exclusive membership portal gives you access to premium services, rewards, and a growing network of like-minded professionals. Explore what's available to you today.
